extracted.name: Tomato Mozzarella Salad
extracted.description: This tomato mozzarella salad, or caprese, is the perfect summer salad to make with creamy mozzarella, juicy tomatoes, and lots of fresh basil.
instruction_lines: Place tomato slices, alternating with mozzarella slices, on a large serving platter.
Combine oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper in a jar with a tight-fitting lid; shake well.
Drizzle over tomatoes and mozzarella; sprinkle with basil.
